name: Lake Atitlán
tagline: A volcano-ringed lake of Maya villages
summary: Lake Atitlán is a deep blue lake surrounded by three volcanoes and Maya villages, each with its own character. Ride boats between villages: Panajachel, San Juan La Laguna for weaving co-ops, San Marcos for yoga, Santiago for the folk saint Maximón. Hike Indian Nose at sunrise and shop at the Chichicastenango market.
seasonNote: Dry November to April; afternoon winds make boats choppy.
arrival: About 3 hours by shuttle from Antigua.
gettingAround: Public boats (lanchas) between villages; tuk-tuks in villages.
cashTip: Carry quetzales for boats and markets; cards work in some hotels. Tip about 10 percent.
foodTip: Pepián stew, lake fish and Guatemalan coffee.
baseArea: Panajachel, San Juan or San Marcos
